name: demosaic
expr: R1 = demosaic(I, 'rggb'); R2 = demosaic(I, 'bggr'); R3 = demosaic(I, 'grbg'); R4 = demosaic(I, 'gbrg'); Rc = demosaic(Ic, 'rggb'); Rg = demosaic(Ig, 'rggb'); R16 = demosaic(I16, 'rggb'); Rb = demosaic(I16, 'rggb', 'BitsPerSample', 12);
comment: demosaic — Bayer mosaic → RGB via Malvar-He-Cutler 2004. Covers all 4 sensor alignments (rggb/bggr/grbg/gbrg), constant DC preservation, distinguishable pattern (verified interior + boundary), smooth gradient, uint16 class preservation, BitsPerSample NV (accept-and-ignore per MATLAB behavior). Boundary uses mirror-through-pixel-1 (Bayer-preserving).
